data_fields.name: portal_trigger_radius
data_fields.donor_constant: 2.0 default when portal.radius <= 0; realm pair radius 2.0

data_fields.name: portal_landing_offset_from_own_trigger
data_fields.donor_constant: convention only (landing outside own radius); realm arithmetic 4.95 and 5.02 units

best_idea: Move zone-to-zone transitions into the server tick as plain data pairs (a trigger radius and a landing per side) that run through one shared teleport recipe, and make a data test prove each landing sits outside its own trigger.
decision_why: The donor pairs are 2D and rely on a landing-outside-radius convention the code read does not enforce; Frankendom keeps the data shape and the server-side move, and adds the landing check as a data test instead of copying the convention.
acceptance: A server test loads every zone portal, asserts the landing check for each side, and walks a test player into side A: it arrives at side B's landing in one sim tick, is not moved again on the next tick, and the zone change is logged once.
